conviction_note: The H1 numbers were pre-released on 2026-08-28 (OP -400m against a +100m plan), and the stock has fallen about 26% since. What the 11:00 release adds is whether the full-year OP plan of 2.1bn yen, reaffirmed on 08-28, survives. September department-store data (autumn clothing strong, cool weather) make a hold with upbeat H2 commentary more likely than a cut, and margin shorts outnumber longs (0.81). That gives a mild positive lean: findings +1.0 and scaled +0.45 (p_up 57 x abs 3.2). The scaled number is smaller because the cut risk on a stretched H2 (+65% OP needed) is real and the September read-through is a proxy.
bar: Company's own revised H1 forecast of 2026-08-28: sales 25,700m, OP -400m, ordinary -360m, NP -480m; full-year held at sales 60,000m / OP 2,100m / NP 4,020m (https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120260826526581.pdf). No sell-side consensus exists: kabuyoho shows no analyst consensus (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportTop?bcode=8011), and 四季報 could not be reached. The bar is therefore the company plan alone, so every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register as of 2026-09-29: 1.68% across 2 sellers, down from 1.78% (covering), source https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html via baseline. 信用倍率 0.81 (margin shorts exceed longs), shown on kabutan's stock page (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=8011). No options, so no skew. priced_lean_pct +1.655, mostly the short-squeeze component. 20-day run-up -8.0%, 5-day -0.5%; the stock is about -26% from the 2026-08-27 close of 1753 to the 10-05 close of 1297. Activists AVI (13.07% -> 7.74%) and Sapphireterra (8.12% -> 4.97%) sold into the 08-31 ToSTNeT-3 buyback.

findings.finding: The full-year plan (OP 2.1bn, sales 60bn) was explicitly reaffirmed on 2026-08-28 although H1 OP was cut to -400m. The first month of H2 then ran in the company's favour: in September 2026 all major department stores reported strong autumn clothing sales, with Tokyo cooler than normal for the first time in five years (Mitsukoshi Isetan +11.0%, Takashimaya +4.0%, Hankyu Hanshin +9.5%). Department stores are 651 of Sanyo's 737 outlets. A hold with upbeat H2 commentary at this print is therefore more likely than a cut, and after a ~26% drawdown since the revision a hold reads as relief.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Kabutan's revision log shows Sanyo revised the full-year plan at the H1 print in 2022 (22/10/06) and 2023 (23/10/06), but not in 2024 or 2025. Last year the full-year cut came on 25/08/28 and again on 26/02/27. Last year's H1 print window (2025-10-06/07) moved about +2.1% and then -2.9% (Yahoo daily bars). The estimated-cadence median reaction is 2.92%.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock fell from 1753 (08-27) to 1297 (10-05). If the market believed the reaffirmed plan, it would not have taken a quarter off the price in five weeks while the company kept the plan, the dividend policy (DOE 5%) and completed a 9.2% buyback. The September department-store data is a counterparty series published on 10-01/02 in the trade press, and no analyst covers the name to translate it into a Sanyo H2 view. Margin shorts exceeding longs (0.81) says the leveraged side is positioned for the cut, not the hold.
findings.independence: The company's own August 月次 (2026-09-07): July-August proper sales +8% year on year and gross margin +3.3pt, the basis it gave for holding the full year (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8011&b=n202609080921). This is a different document from the department-store data (https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-10-02/department-store-sales-september2026/). Counterweight, already sized into the range: H2 needs OP of about 2.5bn against 1.51bn in the prior-year H2, and sales up about 9% against H1 down 5%. That stretch is why the low end is -3.5.

findings.finding: The H1 period was pre-released on 2026-08-28, two business days before period end (sales 25.7bn, OP -400m). The reported numbers will land close to that and are not news. Japanese issuers that revise this late usually land at or slightly above the revised figure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the revision day, 2026-08-28 (13:00 release), the stock closed -3.7% (1753 -> 1688) and kept falling for ten sessions, with activist selling cited (kabutan 09-08).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. That is why this finding is sized near zero; it is filed because it sets what the release does not add.
findings.independence: The August 月次 (2026-09-07) shows H1 sales at 96% of the prior year, consistent with the 25.7bn revised figure against 27.0bn last year (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8011&b=n202609080921).

findings.finding: Two activists cut their stakes into the 08-31 ToSTNeT-3 buyback, and the 10-session slide that followed was attributed to that exit: AVI went from 13.07% to 7.74% and is no longer the top holder, and Sapphireterra went from 8.12% to 4.97%. Both still hold stakes (about 12.7% combined) that can be sold into any relief rally.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 09-08, after the large-holding reports were filed on 09-07, the stock fell 5.6% to 1333, its tenth straight decline (kabutan / MINKABU).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stake cuts are public and the price has absorbed a 21% fall since the buyback price of 1688. What is left is supply that could cap a rally inside the window, so this finding is small.
findings.independence: The company's major-shareholder notice of 2026-09-08 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8011&b=n202609090412) and the FASHIONSNAP report (https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-09-09/sanyo-shareholder-change/) rest on the same EDINET filings, so this is one fact.

findings.finding: The capital-return frame is generous and could be extended at the H1 print. The dividend policy was raised to DOE 5% on 06-30: interim 76 yen pre-split and year-end 36 yen post-split, about 4.6% at spot. A 9.2% buyback was completed on 08-31. Net cash was 167億 at the FY26/2 year-end, and the mid-term plan says '業績進捗に応じた更なる株主還元強化の検討'. Against that, the company set up an M&A-focused 新規事業開発部 on 10-01, which points cash at acquisitions rather than another buyback.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-06-30 Q1 print (11:00), which carried the DOE 5% raise, was followed by a rise from about 1517 (07-23) to 1840 (08-25), with the split and 優待 expansion in between. The ToSTNeT-3 day (08-28) closed -3.7% on the same-day H1 revision.
findings.why_not_priced: A new buyback is not in the price, because the last one closed five weeks ago and nobody expects another this soon. If one came, the stock would show it. The finding is small because I found no document saying one is coming, and the M&A department cuts the other way.
findings.independence: The mid-term plan progress deck of 2026-04-14 gives net cash of 167億 and the return policy (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260414/140120260413502628.pdf). The M&A department notice of 2026-10-01 is the counterweight (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8011&b=n202610011111).

outside_window.finding: Sale of part of the head-office land: a 2.8bn yen special gain, booked in FY28/2 with delivery in August 2027. It is not in the FY27/2 net-profit plan.
The September 2026 月次 from Sanyo itself, likely published about 10-07 or later. The August one came out on 09-07 after the close.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: H1 is pre-released, the full year was reaffirmed 08-28, and the open question is hold vs cut, with hold more likely given strong September department-store autumn sales. Returns: DOE 5% and a 9.2% buyback are already done; a new buyback is possible but undocumented. New-year guide: n/a (H1 print). Quarter vs own 進捗率: H1 OP -400m against a full year of +2,100m. Last year's H1 OP of -213m ended a year at 1,298m, so H2 seasonality is strong, but this year's H2 has to reach about 2,500m.

Separate finding that the full-year plan is stretched (H2 OP +65% needed), a likely cut
rejected_candidates.detail: Merged into the guidance finding, which lands on the same hold/cut decision. One sign, with the cut risk carried in its low end of -3.5

baseline_tension: Agrees with priced_lean_pct (+1.655, short-squeeze driven) and cuts against nothing strong. The 20-day run-up of -8% fits a mean-reversion lean too, so the finding is only partly incremental to the free control. The strongest negative the release could carry is a full-year OP cut. I looked for it and found the company's own 08-28 reasoning for holding, plus September channel data that supports a hold.
lessons_applied: Open question 3 (a pre-released H1 tends to make the print small, one case at +0.13%): pre-released quarter finding trimmed from +0.2 to +0.1 and abs_move_pct cut from 3.5 to 3.2. Not cut further because the full-year hold/cut is still open.
Rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次: p_up toward 50): not triggered; the one negative is positioning supply, not a visible miss.
Rule 2 (check the sign): the strongest positive (a held forecast or a buyback) was searched for and is the main finding; p_up left at 57.
